title: Onrus Markie
summary: A monthly neighbourhood market on the 1st Saturday of the month from 9 to 12 at De Wet Saal, Roos St., Onrus.
description: A monthly neighbourhood market on the 1st Sat. of the month from 9-12 at De Wet Saal, Roos St., Onrus
profile: A neighbourhood market held on the first Saturday of every month from 9am to midday at the De Wet Hall on Roos Street in Onrus. Visitors browse the stalls and meet locals on a Saturday morning. It suits anyone staying around Onrus and Vermont at the start of a month.
